name: diffctx
description: Selects the minimum code an LLM needs to review a git diff

impact_hook.title: Impact of each commit, merge and push
impact_hook.description: Once a git commit/merge/cherry-pick/revert/push has run, before a PR is created, and after a git diff or git status, show what the change reaches outside the diff (once per change, never blocks)

impact_gate.title: Strict gate: no commit before its impact was reviewed
impact_gate.description: Deny a git commit until the impact of the index it records has been shown once (by the hook, a manual --mode impact run, or the /diffctx:impact skill); the retry passes. A commit line that stages for itself (git add on the same line, paths, -a) is asked to stage first. Fixing a caller changes the content, so the next attempt is denied once more with the new impact.
